name: Mainichikoh — Classic Sandalwood (毎日香 小型バラ詰)
description: The original Mainichikoh: the sandalwood stick incense Nippon Kodo has made since the Meiji era, and the scent most Japanese homes associate with the family altar. Normal smoke and a fuller sandalwood than the Natural line. A low-smoke version (けむり少ない) also exists. Not yet reviewed on the shelf.
dek: Nippon Kodo · the original · ¥484 small bulk box
